blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has gained international recognition for its performance improvements in the 2025 Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA). According to a DepEd statement on Friday, Dean Nonie Lesaux of the Harvard Graduate School of Education (HGSE) praised the country’s educational trajectory during a forum organized by the Harvard Club of the Philippines Global at the Manila House Private Club in Bonifacio Global City. Education Secretary Sonny Angara, who earned his Master of Laws degree from Harvard Law School, welcomed the commendation, saying: “We deeply appreciate Dean Lesaux and the global education community noticing the significant […]...
